mapper.sql: id,connector_id AS connectorId,item_type AS itemType,external_id AS externalId,title,item_url AS itemUrl,excerpt,attributes_json AS attributesJson,raw_json AS rawJson,remote_updated_at AS remoteUpdatedAt,synced_time AS syncedTime,created_time AS createdTime,updated_time AS updatedTime

sql.if: AND (title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR external_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_connector_item(connector_id,item_type,external_id,title,item_url,excerpt,attributes_json,raw_json,remote_updated_at,synced_time) VALUES(#{connectorId},#{itemType},#{externalId},#{title},#{itemUrl},#{excerpt},#{attributesJson},#{rawJson},#{remoteUpdatedAt},CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE item_type=VALUES(item_type),title=VALUES(title),item_url=VALUES(item_url),excerpt=VALUES(excerpt),attributes_json=VALUES(attributes_json),raw_json=VALUES(raw_json),remote_updated_at=VALUES(remote_updated_at),synced_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_connector_item WHERE connector_id=#{connectorId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_connector_item WHERE connector_id=#{connectorId}
SELECT item_type AS itemType, COUNT(*) AS total FROM t_connector_item WHERE connector_id=#{connectorId} GROUP BY item_type ORDER BY total DESC, item_type
